Headline: #11 Lincoln Temporary Reroute at Lincoln/Bryn Mawr
ShortDescription: 11 Lincoln buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Lincoln/Bryn Mawr.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#11 Lincoln buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Lincoln, Foster, Western, Bryn Mawr and Lincoln over to regular route, due to street blockage near Lincoln/Bryn Mawr.

Allow extra travel time.
